118    pub(crate) struct mask32x8<S: Simd> {
119        val: [bool; SIMD_WIDTH],
120        _marker: PhantomData<S>,
121    }
122
123    impl<S: Simd> mask32x8<S> {
124        #[inline(always)]
125        pub(crate) fn select(self, if_true: u32x8<S>, if_false: u32x8<S>) -> u32x8<S> {
126            let mut result = [0u32; SIMD_WIDTH];
127            for i in 0..SIMD_WIDTH {
128                result[i] = if self.val[i] { if_true.val[i] } else { if_false.val[i] };
129            }
130            u32x8 { val: result, _marker: PhantomData }
131        }
132    }

138        pub(super) val: [u32; SIMD_WIDTH],
139        _marker: PhantomData<S>,
140    }

142    impl<S: Simd> u32x8<S> {
143        #[inline(always)]
144        pub(crate) fn from_slice(_simd: S, slice: &[u32]) -> Self {
145            let mut val = [0u32; SIMD_WIDTH];
146            val.copy_from_slice(&slice[..SIMD_WIDTH]);
147            Self { val, _marker: PhantomData }
148        }
149
150        #[inline(always)]
151        pub(crate) fn splat(_simd: S, val: u32) -> Self {
152            Self { val: [val; SIMD_WIDTH], _marker: PhantomData }
153        }
154
155        #[inline(always)]
156        pub(crate) fn store(self, slice: &mut [u32]) {
157            slice[..SIMD_WIDTH].copy_from_slice(&self.val);
158        }
159
160        #[inline(always)]
161        pub(crate) fn simd_gt(self, other: Self) -> mask32x8<S> {
162            let mut result = [false; SIMD_WIDTH];
163            for i in 0..SIMD_WIDTH {
164                result[i] = self.val[i] > other.val[i];
165            }
166            mask32x8 { val: result, _marker: PhantomData }
167        }
168    }
